adapter.S1_split: within-class chronological first 70% train, final 30% validation
adapter.name: classifier_head_only_supervised
adapter.target_anchor: target-specific outcome-fold ERM anchor that never saw the target

backbone_decomposition.predictor_scaling: mechanism score standardized over the 82 development rows for descriptive full-development decomposition

cross_validation.classifier: sklearn LogisticRegression, L2, C=1, solver=liblinear, max_iter=2000, random_state=0
cross_validation.constant_fallback: training-fold prevalence if no features or a training fold contains one class

M4.description: No legally available frozen target-subject Identity I. Existing identity_probe.csv is a model-fit-domain aggregate, not a target-level score; it is not remapped, retrained, or fabricated.

cross_validation.outer: the existing five subject-disjoint outcome folds; both backbone rows of each held-out subject remain together
cross_validation.preprocessing: continuous predictors standardized using training fold mean and SD only; backbone is a binary indicator
cross_validation.uncertainty: 10000 subject bootstrap resamples; both backbone rows resampled as one cluster

feature_definitions.adaptation_effect: adapted correct-class margin minus anchor correct-class margin for the same trial
feature_definitions.adaptation_effect_stability: For the adaptation-effect scalar, within each class compute abs(mean(S1val)-mean(S2))/sqrt((var(S1val)+var(S2))/2); score is negative mean across classes.
feature_definitions.binary_correct_class_margin: z[y] - z[1-y] (equivalently twice the correct-class centered logit)
feature_definitions.certificate_precision: Within each seed, paired class-stratified S2 bootstrap (2000 resamples) of Delta2 BA; SE=bootstrap SD, SNR=Delta2/SE, LCB90=Delta2-1.2815515655*SE.
feature_definitions.controls: raw Delta2, S1 head parameter-relative change, and S1-validation anchor mean maximum softmax confidence
feature_definitions.decision_stability: For anchor correct-class margins, within each class compute abs(mean(S1val)-mean(S2))/sqrt((var(S1val)+var(S2))/2); score is negative mean across classes, so larger is more stable.
feature_definitions.identity: No legally available frozen target-subject Identity I. Existing identity_probe.csv is a model-fit-domain aggregate, not a target-level score; it is not remapped, retrained, or fabricated.
feature_definitions.representation_layer: frozen anchor final embedding returned by forward_features; no alternate layer
feature_definitions.representation_stability: Within each class compute Euclidean S1val-to-S2 final-embedding centroid distance divided by sqrt(mean of the two within-session mean squared radii); score is negative mean across classes.

outcomes.R_sign: 1[np.sign(Delta2)==np.sign(Delta3)]; exact zero is concordant only with exact zero

policy.execution_eligibility: At least one of M3/M5/M6/M7/M8 must have OOF AUROC>=0.55 for R_sign or safe_given_positive_certificate and improve over the better of M1/M2 by >=0.02 on the same outcome.
policy.held_out_application: fit M8 on all eligible outer-training positive certificates and apply the training-selected threshold to held-out subjects
policy.model: M8 fixed four-scalar logistic model fit only among Delta2-positive training rows to predict safe_given_positive_certificate
policy.threshold_selection: For each outer fold, create inner OOF training-subject predictions using the remaining frozen folds; among thresholds giving overall training-row coverage >=0.20, minimize training harmful-accepted rate, then prefer greater coverage/lower threshold. Never use held-out outcomes.

session_roles.S2_ses_1: historical certificate and all predictor features
session_roles.S3_ses_2: outcome definition only after feature lock

success_gates.A: All final predictors use only S1/S2; mandatory.
success_gates.B: A predeclared mechanism model has OOF AUROC>=0.60, subject-bootstrap lower 95% bound>0.50, and AUROC improvement>=0.03 over both M1 and M2 on R_sign or safe_given_positive_certificate.
success_gates.C: For a Gate-B mechanism, adding it reduces absolute backbone coefficient by >=20% and improves logistic deviance by >=2 versus backbone-only; the interaction magnitude must not exceed twice the main mechanism magnitude.
success_gates.D: Reliability gate reduces harmful accepted certificates by >=25% relative to the simple Delta2-positive gate.
success_gates.F: Reliability-gated mean S3 BA is no more than 0.002 below Anchor mean S3 BA.

terminal_rule.not_supported: no predeclared mechanism reaches directional OOF AUROC>=0.55, or any prospective-purity gate fails
terminal_rule.partial: Gate A passes and there is directionally positive predeclared mechanism evidence (OOF AUROC>=0.55 for R_sign or safe certificates) but all Gates A-F do not pass

trial_and_seed_aggregation.class_aggregation: unweighted arithmetic mean of class-0 and class-1 scalars
trial_and_seed_aggregation.seed_aggregation: compute every scalar per seed, then arithmetic mean across the three matched seeds within subject/backbone
trial_and_seed_aggregation.statistical_unit: subject; paired backbone rows retained together in all folds and bootstrap resamples
